fingerprint: canonical request intent including operation and mutation payload
sameFingerprintCompleted: replay stored status and response without repeating side effects
sameFingerprintInProgress: reject deterministically as request in progress
storageRequirement: critical mutations persist the idempotency record in the same authoritative transaction or an equivalently atomic boundary
authority: idempotency metadata never decides auction winner, accepted bid ordering, eligibility, price, or finalization
